newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins rise with Bradies, seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins rise with Bradies, seen higher.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose and dealers said on Thursday the new trend was in line with firmer Brady bonds as new positions were opened after a few days of profit-taking.
They said prices were generally likely to rise in the longer term, as wider yield spreads over U.S. Treasuries, which are firming themselves, made MinFins more attractive.
"The rise has been going on since yesterday evening. People have apparently cashed in all they wanted and we are going up with Bradies," one dealer said.
The rise started late on Wednesday, despite neutral U.S. June consumer prices, dealers said, and added today's U.S. data on June housing starts made no visible impact on the market.
"Wider spreads over Treasuries are making MinFins interesting both for short and long-term investments. Prices are going up on short-covering and investor demand," another dealer said.
